participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Curious and creative, Alex enjoys exploring new ideas and expressing them through writing. He has a laid-back attitude and embraces his laziness as a time for reflection.
participant_1.background: A writer based in Kiev, Alex has a passion for storytelling and technology, particularly robotics. He is always looking for inspiration in everyday life.

participant_2.name: Jamie
participant_2.personality: Enthusiastic and supportive, Jamie is a high school student who is passionate about psychology and enjoys engaging with others. Her friendly nature makes her approachable.
participant_2.background: Currently a high school student with aspirations to become a psychologist, Jamie balances her studies with being a coach and a mother. She is motivated to help others and is actively involved in her community.
